title: Low-degree sample solver
statement: For natural numbers $n,\ell,m$ and $m$ labeled samples consisting of an input in $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ and a label in $\mathbb{F}_2$, define the returned low-degree hypothesis by applying the binary linear row solver to the equations formed from those samples, with one coefficient for each monomial of degree at most $\ell$.
